summary: BUG-672 QA — Prepaid/Walk-In order Credit payment flow on TGK (owner@thegoankitchen.com). Full end-to-end test: Collect Bill → Credit → Pay → verify in Credit Management. RESULT: PASS

blocker_notes: The scan-order-popout-backdrop (data-testid) has z-index full-screen which blocks all standard Playwright clicks on dashboard elements. Workaround: use element.click() via page.evaluate() JS injection to bypass DOM-level interception. This is a known issue from prior sessions — not a code bug, it's by design (popup persists until Accept/Reject).
